description: 한국철도공사_발권/이동유형 통계정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. 한국철도공사 이동/발권유형 통계정보 데이터로, 간선열차 객실별 이용인원 통계, 간선열차 거리별 이용인원 통계, 간선열차 노선별 이용인원 통계, 간선열차 발권유형 통계, 간선열차 역별. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도공사. Its tags are 발권, 이동유형, 통계데이터, 유형통계, 현황통계. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-12-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
